description:
Goal: the fact engine and the product pull system are one engine. A key is demanded, the producer registered for it runs, and producers (jobs, artifact, backend, transport, reach code) live outside the engine core. The engine is the one authority on which cycle group a waiting derivation is in, and a group concludes together. The engine lives in its own crate at crates/fz-engine.

Why: today the compiler answers 'which cycle am I in?' in eight places (Reach Static/Direct/All products, pull.rs pending_strong_component, World::waits_reach, revive_blocked_chain, runtime_demand in-run settlement, ForwardingWalk). On even/odd the same pair {even, odd} is found independently 3 times (5 with a list argument); on the distiller waits_reach runs 56,562 times and pending_strong_component 16,005 times. The pull system duplicates memo, readers, wake waves, pending records, readiness; 168 distiller re-evaluations are missed cycles from that duplicate (pending records dropped by settle Wake/Invalidate).

Signal: per-mechanism run counts (instrumentation in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/dist/cycles/observation.diff), distiller jobs/requests/instructions, backend dumps byte-identical, work pins (every rise reported with a per-subject diff for the user's call).

Strategy: .agent/strategies/paper-first.md; each child starts from a probe with a written prediction. Prior refutations every child must account for: fz-229 (static component != acyclic: StaticCallees omits closure/dispatch/function-ref edges; settled readiness oscillates while content ascends) and fz-afu.15's S1-S5 (a climb advances by revision wakes, not standing waits, so 'no queued work in the group' also holds between steps).

Evidence: proposal page /Users/j5n/Workspace/scheduling-rework.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/Nyhz6UAdsY4sS4ysLtSdjY); explainer https://claude.ai/artifact/KCh2AyL5KVeUC1XfpQkewN; spikes /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/dist/ids2/report.md (engine-owned ids, -7.4% distiller instructions, dumps identical), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/dist/reachfact/report.md (Reach(Static) as an ordinary fact: no core change, dumps identical, 3 work pins + distiller largest drive +4), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/dist/cycles/report.md (inventory, even/odd hand answer and counts).

Out of scope: dispatch.rs collect_requirements (source error check) and native.rs annotate_back_edges (CFG loops).
title: [EPIC] One engine: a demanded key runs its registered producer, and the engine owns cycle groups
